svg.text: STAGE 390 · TOPIC 30 FAQ
SIP RFC 4028 Zombie Call Reaper & WebRTC RFC 7675 ICE Consent Guard
Session-Expires 90–180s + 15–30s RTP Dead-Air Reaper (P773) & RFC 7675 <=30s ICE Consent Loss + <=60s TURN Reaper (P774)
1. SIP RFC 4028 Session-Timer & Half-Open RTP Zombie Reaper (P773)
❌ Anti-Pattern: Missing SIP BYE Leaves 4-Hour S2S Zombie Sessions
• Caller enters tunnel or phone battery dies -> carrier drops radio without SIP BYE
• S2S Voice Agent stays open for hours, burning $0.18/min ($43.20/call) on dead air
• Result: Massive runaway S2S token bills & SBC RTP UDP port pool exhaustion
✅ Production Pattern: RFC 4028 Session-Expires + 15–30s RTP Watchdog (P773)
1. Signaling Heartbeat: Negotiate RFC 4028 Session-Expires in [90s, 180s] (UPDATE)
2. Fast Media Watchdog: Monitor inbound RTP/RTCP; trigger timeout in 15s–30s
3. Clean Q.850 Teardown: Emit SIP BYE (Reason: Q.850;cause=31) & close S2S socket
4. Zero Runaway Billing: Caps dead-air zombie call cost at <=30s ($0.09 max)
Deterministic Invariant (evaluateSipRfc4028SessionTimer...):
sessionExpiresSec in [90, 180] && maxRtpDeadAirWatchdogSec in [15, 30]
2. WebRTC RFC 7675 ICE Consent & Zombie TURN Port Reaper (P774)
❌ Anti-Pattern: Unchecked STUN Consent Loss & 600s Dangling TURN Ports
• Crashed mobile app or NAT rebind leaves TURN relay allocation open for 600s
• Server keeps pumping TTS UDP packets to recycled NAT IP without ICE consent
• Result: Ephemeral UDP port exhaustion (49152–65535) & unconsented UDP flood
✅ Production Pattern: RFC 7675 <=30s Consent + <=60s TURN Reaper (P774)
1. Randomized STUN Probes: Send ICE Binding Requests every 4s–6s (RFC 7675)
2. Immediate Consent Revocation: Halt media in <=30s on missing STUN responses
3. Aggressive TURN Reaping: Reclaim idle RFC 8656 TURN relay ports in <=60s
4. 92% Port Pool Recovery: Prevents CGNAT/TURN ephemeral port exhaustion
Deterministic Invariant (evaluateWebrtcRfc7675IceConsent...):
maxIceConsentLossTimeoutSec <= 30s && maxIdleTurnAllocationSec <= 60s
Stage 390 Quantitative Verification & Measurement Provenance (393 Dimensions · 783 Guardrails · 792 Probes · 832 Unit Tests)
• SIP Zombie Reaper (P773): Caps runaway dead-air S2S billing at <=30s; ICE Consent Reaper (P774): Reclaims 92% of zombie TURN UDP ports.
